title: John 1:1 — gematria 3627 shown as a trapezoid of red dots
summary: John 1:1 in English ("In (the) beginning was the Word and the Word was with God and God was the Word.") with its Greek-letter total 3627 shown at the top and again under a large trapezoid made of tiny red dots. The word Word is in red; some letters of In and God are coloured individually.

keywords: In the beginning was the Word
